title: Are you a hireling?
segments: Are you a hireling? It's going to be a
class on self-examination. There's a lot
of things going on in the world and a
lot of brothers and sisters are
interested in coming into the truth. A
lot of brothers and sisters already in
the truth. Some of us, some of you, some
of we, might be hirelings. So, we're
going to examine it according to the
scriptures to see if we are truly about
God's business or are we just waiting
for opportunity to bounce when we get
to new job, some new butt,
new wife, new husband, whatever it is.
Are you a hireling? So, that's what
we're going to examine today, all right?
